# AmbiguousMethodsCallsInArrayMapping

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" />

Group: [Performance](/rules/#performance) · PhpStorm name: `AmbiguousMethodsCallsInArrayMappingInspection`

When a loop builds a map like `$map[key($x)] = key($x);`, the same call is
evaluated twice per iteration (once for the key, once for the value). Compute
it once into a local variable.

## Example

```php{3,4,5,6,7,18}
<?php
foreach ($users as $user) {
    $byEmail[$user->email()] = $user->email();
    $byName[strtolower($user)] = strtolower($user);
    $byName[(strtolower($user))] .= strtolower( $user );
    $tagged['u:' . md5($user)] = $cache[md5($user)];
    $groups[Role::of($user)][] = Role::of($user);

    $byName[strtolower($user)] = true;
    $plain['x'] = strtolower($user);
    $other[md5($user)] = md5($guest);
    if ($user) {
        $skip[md5($user)] = md5($user);
    }
}

for ($i = 0; $i < 9; $i++) {
    $sq[abs($i)] = abs($i);
}

while ($row = next($rows)) {
    $ids[key($row)] = key($row);
}

foreach ($streams as $h) {
    $lines[fgets($h)] = fgets($h);
    $pairs[next($h)] = next($h);
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: This call is repeated in the key; store its result in a local variable.</li>
<li>line 4: This call is repeated in the key; store its result in a local variable.</li>
<li>line 5: This call is repeated in the key; store its result in a local variable.</li>
<li>line 6: This call is repeated in the key; store its result in a local variable.</li>
<li>line 7: This call is repeated in the key; store its result in a local variable.</li>
<li>line 18: This call is repeated in the key; store its result in a local variable.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "AmbiguousMethodsCallsInArrayMapping": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore AmbiguousMethodsCallsInArrayMapping

/**
 * @noinspection AmbiguousMethodsCallsInArrayMappingInspection
 */
```
